added.definition: when this record was added, ISO yyyy-mm-dd

brand.definition: the selling brand; equals the manufacturer except for house brands

frequency_response.definition: the published SPL/impedance chart; the document is the origin's indexed URL (no separate source_url copy); numeric digitisation pending

impedance.definition: the published impedance magnitude curve; the document is the origin's indexed URL (no separate source_url copy); numeric digitisation pending

data_sources.definition: the record-wide provenance index — every source role used anywhere in this file resolves to a URL here

description.definition: the manufacturer's own product blurb, page chrome stripped
description.value: The Dayton Audio CFC100-4 is an affordable 4-ohm 3-1/2" full-range woofer designed to deliver clean, detailed sound from a compact footprint. Its woven carbon fiber cone combines low mass with excellent rigidity, while the aluminum voice coil former and low-loss rubber surround help maintain controlled, responsive performance. With a broad 90 to 12,000 Hz frequency range, the CFC100-4 is well suited for compact speaker designs that need strong midrange clarity and useful high-frequency extension. Product Highlights Woven carbon fiber cone provides excellent rigidity with low moving mass Low-loss rubber surround and large flat spider allow smooth, linear cone movement 20 mm 2-layer voice coil on an aluminum former supports controlled, responsive operation Low-profile stamped steel frame works well for flush or surface mounting Broad 90 to 12,000 Hz response delivers impressive bandwidth from a compact, affordable driver

driver_type.definition: what kind of driver this is (closed vocabulary); decides which specs section applies

manufacturer.definition: the company that makes the driver; a second-order descriptive field, shown only when it differs from the brand

model.definition: the vendor's exact designation including the impedance variant — unique within a brand, and the name shown in the driver browser
model.value: CFC100-4 3-1/2" Carbon Fiber Full Range Woofer 4 Ohm

product_image.definition: the manufacturer's product photo for this driver

provided_by.definition: who supplied this record — the OpenISD project for a pipeline-emitted record

datasheet_fallback.definition: provenance note naming the falling datasheet

value.reason: the daytonaudio.com-linked datasheet failed printed-code verification

pdf_corroboration.definition: the extract-stage HTML↔PDF field comparison record

scraper.definition: the vendor scraper/extraction method that produced this record

series.definition: the vendor's product line this driver belongs to

sku.definition: the canonical identity code — the vendor designation slugified, impedance variant included; names the record directory (guard-enforced equal) and is unique within the manufacturer

grounds.definition: the printed designation the code was derived from
grounds.reading: CFC100-4 3-1/2" Carbon Fiber Full Range Woofer 4 Ohm

grounds.definition: the source URL that corroborated the derivation

Basket_m.definition: basket diameter — the baffle cutout, stored in m

Mms_kg.definition: moving mass including air load — stored in kg, not g

Sd_m2.definition: effective piston area — stored in m², not cm²

Vas_m3.definition: equivalent compliance volume — stored in m³, not litres

Vcd_m.definition: voice coil diameter — stored in m, not mm

Xmax_m.definition: one-way linear excursion limit — stored in m, not mm

surround_material.definition: surround material (controlled vocabulary; unknown values DQ-flagged)

uuid.definition: stable record identity, minted by the pipeline at first emit and never re-derived
